evidence.computation: Joint acoustic Doppler shift binds source and listener motion relative to a stationary medium and evaluates one combined expression.
assumptions: Each actor's motion is along the propagation line, with a separately bound direction.
Explicit wind or moving-medium conditions, unresolved actor roles and speeds outside the stated model are consumed model refusals.
untrusted: English role and unit interpretation, numeric lexing and JSON framing remain untrusted.
